title: Mauritania calculator-readiness follow-up — Batch 28
prior_work: A Batch 11 review already exists. The 15 administrative wilayas were already present in the regional lookup; no duplicate regions were added.
new_evidence: Ministry of Agriculture 2025-26 headline: 985,000 tonnes total agricultural production, about 700,000 tonnes cereals and 556,000 tonnes rice; definitions and underlying tables still require verification.
Trarza development pole: 800,000 ha development envelope, 53,000 ha prepared for rice and 10,000 ha for vegetables; these are not automatically actual harvested areas.
FAO GIEWS 28 October 2026: 2026 coarse-grain harvest underway; rice harvest expected November-December; localized Gorgol shortfall risk and below-average rangeland/water in some areas.

World Bank monthly price panel: opened catalogue metadata describes 34 markets through April 2026 and modelled market prices; not farmgate evidence. Search index surfaced a later version with different coverage, requiring metadata reconciliation.
existing_evidence_preserved: 2024/25 rice 481,854 tonnes on 97,444 ha (secondary government trade-agency summary citing FAO)
Autumn 2025 rice 229,353 tonnes on 48,800 ha (Ministry figures reported by MADAR), with Trarza 206,005 t, Gorgol 13,217 t and Brakna 10,131 t; seasonal scope retained
blockers: Original Ministry crop tables and crop-by-wilaya data
Regional enterprise budgets for multiple production systems
Livestock species-specific costs and output prices
safeguards: Do not combine annual and seasonal rice totals
Do not treat prepared development-pole hectares as harvested area
Do not treat modelled retail market prices as farmgate prices
Do not change the original ten active countries

sources.title: Mauritania Ministry of Agriculture — Trarza development pole and national production update
FAO GIEWS Mauritania, reference date 28 October 2026
World Bank Mauritania monthly food price estimates
